user_prompt: I need to submit a new infrastructure update request that will impact multiple departments, and I need the system to automatically assess whether this change requires executive approval based on the business scope. Can you walk me through the entire process from when I submit the request through final implementation, including tracking any related equipment modifications and service dependencies? I also need documentation of all regulatory requirements that apply to this change, as well as any existing maintenance schedules we should coordinate with during rollout.

steps.step_name: Review existing maintenance schedules for coordination

args.content:
LANDSCAPE OVERVIEW (10 systems):
- corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

KEY ORDER PROCESSING CHAIN:
1. sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1 — converts qualified opportunities to orders
2. sap.crm:agent:OpportunityQualificationAdvisor:v1 — evaluates opportunities against CustomerAccount characteristics

PROCUREMENT AGENTS (sap.s4, sap.ariba):
- sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1 — matches purchase requisitions to vendors
- sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 — reconciles invoices to POs

PRODUCT LIFECYCLE & MATERIALS TRACKING (siemens.plm, sap.s4):
- siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 — coordinates engineering changes across product items/materials, syncs config updates, tracks material lifecycle
- siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1 — validates BOM against regulatory/supplier standards
- sap.s4:agent:AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator:v1 — coordinates engineering changes across materials & product items with asset provisioning
- sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1 — validates material specs & automates BOM updates

INCIDENT MGMT & EQUIPMENT (corp.itsm):
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 — analyzes incidents to identify root causes, references ITEquipment entity
- corp.itsm:agent:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator:v1 — manages asset lifecycle provisioning, not documentation
- corp.itsm:agent:ChangeAutomationOrchestrator:v1 — automates change coordination across materials/product items
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentSafetyCoordinator:v1 — manages safety incidents
- corp.itsm:agent:OccupationalSafetyIncidentCoordinator:v1 — manages occupational safety incidents

MISSING CAPABILITIES:
1. Maintenance schedule review/coordination — NO resource found that reviews or coordinates maintenance schedules
2. Equipment documentation updates (no agent found that updates equipment metadata/docs post-incident)
3. Order fulfillment checkpoint tracking
4. Customer grievance/complaint handling
5. Customer billing dispute resolution
6. Accounts receivable management
7. Customer service management
8. Claims and resolutions documentation
